comparison_to_prior.price_response: roughly flat to slightly higher despite major CVD deterioration

interpretation: Aggressive selling increased materially (CVD fell ~2.46B) while OI stayed nearly flat/down and price did not make a proportional decline. This is strong seller inefficiency / passive bid absorption. The edge is not confirmed until price accepts above dPOC; flow creates the candidate, price acceptance confirms it.

trade_logic.long_trigger: Reclaim and hold/retest above dPOC ~77.34k; stronger continuation above dVAH ~77.93k.
trade_logic.aggressive_entry: Only a small starter if price is already holding near dPOC and risk is tightly defined; do not size full before acceptance.
trade_logic.invalidation: Acceptance back below ~77.2k with CVD continuing down, especially if OI turns higher, invalidates the absorption-long thesis and suggests fresh bearish leverage.
trade_logic.heuristic_probability_note: Any probability attached to this setup is subjective until backtested; do not treat as calibrated odds.

lesson: Large CVD deterioration without corresponding price deterioration is more informative than the absolute CVD level. Seller effort with weak downside price response can be a long-edge candidate, but dPOC acceptance is still required.
